name: aieverything
description: Optional read-only Agent connector for the AIEverything Windows app.

interface.shortDescription: Optional connector for the AIEverything desktop app
interface.longDescription: Connect an Agent to an independently installed AIEverything 1.0.0 desktop app. Search filenames through Everything and the existing local TXT/MD/MARKDOWN body index without changing files or index settings.
defaultPrompt: Find the five most recently modified Markdown files in this project.
Search indexed TXT and Markdown content for the phrase architecture decision.
Find both filenames and indexed text bodies matching benchmark.
